audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed with the packet chart and with its own prose: whys[0] and whys[1] describe Karma dominating levels 1-2 while win[0]/phases[0] said Skill and win[1]/phases[1] said Galio; whys[5] says the stage 'nets out even' while the row said Galio.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Karma, Karma, Skill, Skill, Galio, Skill, Galio and the existing whys already argue exactly that ordering. Karma's Inner Flame is 950 range against Winds of War 825 and Galio's only gap-closer is Justice Punch, which he does not have at level 1.
audit.corrected: Rows 0,1 -> Karma; row 2 -> Skill; row 4 -> Galio (Hero's Entrance dive window); row 5 -> Skill. Proposed in matched full/content pairs as one atomic chart group.
sources: kits: Karma Q range 950, Galio Q range 825

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 phase said 'No new ultimate at 6' without naming what Galio gains, so the reader is told nothing about the actual spike.
audit.why: Mantra is available at level 1 and costs no skill point (Riot text), so Karma gains nothing at 6 while Galio gains Hero's Entrance (180/160/140s, 4000-5500 range) which converts the lane into a dive.
audit.corrected: Level-6 phase now names Hero's Entrance as his dive window and restates that Mantra was live from level 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Justice Punch was referenced only as 'his dash knockup' with no cooldown, and the page never said it can cut off Karma's retreat despite her having no dash.
audit.why: Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7s and is his only gap-closer; Karma's kit has no dash, so a Justice Punch behind her is a death sentence and Flash is the answer. Focused Resolve roots only if the 675 tether is not broken.
audit.corrected: Real cooldown (11s at rank 1) written into the do's, the cooldown block and the loading tip; the retreat-cut line added; 675 tether-break distance written into the level-2 phase.

edits.before: Q poke at level 1 is among the best in the game — chunk Galio on every last-hit and start the Mantra economy.
edits.after: Inner Flame reaches 950 to his Winds of War 825 — chunk him on every last-hit and Mantra is live at level 1.

edits.before: W tether threatens the root — anyone who steps to you early eats Q-W and donates the trade.
edits.after: Focused Resolve roots if he stays inside the 675 tether — anyone stepping up eats Q into root.

edits.before: No new ultimate at 6 — your Mantra has been online since level 1. His spike is the danger window: respect it.
edits.after: He gains Hero's Entrance at 6 and you gain nothing — Mantra was live at level 1, so this stage is his dive window.

edits.before: First item amplifies the RQ chunk — keep him under 60% and the lane stays yours by default.
edits.after: First item sharpens RQ but his MR component blunts the chip — keep him under 60% and it nets even.

edits.before: His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Justice Punch knocks up and is down 11s at rank 1 — commit in that window, never into a fresh E.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - E shield spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — 11s at rank 1, his only gap-closer, and it also cuts your retreat. You have no dash, so hold Flash for that. - E shield spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: - Karma vs Galio - Track: Galio Justice Punch. - Hold the shield for his engage, always. - Justice Punch down is the green light. - Hold the ult for names, not waves.
edits.after: - Karma vs Galio - Track: Justice Punch, 11s at rank 1. - Shield his engage, never your poke. - E on cooldown is your green light to step. - Mantra names, not waves.

notes: Level chart was internally contradictory and disagreed with the packet chart; fixed as matched pairs. Ratings left untouched. Winds of War is a projectile per Riot text but Karma has nothing that blocks projectiles, so no interaction written.
